name: codex-usage-panel
description: Small inline panel for Codex token usage, context occupancy, and provider balance. Auto-detects DeepSeek, OpenAI, OpenRouter, and OpenAI-compatible providers.

interface.shortDescription: Token usage and balance in chat
interface.longDescription: A local, read-only Codex plugin that shows the latest thread token usage, context occupancy, and provider balance. It reads local Codex session logs and queries a configured provider balance endpoint. No session content is uploaded.
